screen.aptitudes.title: Skills & Attributes
skill.aptitudes.mining.desc: Levels by mining stone and ores. Passives: faster mining and ARMOR.
skill.aptitudes.excavation.desc: Levels by digging. Passives: faster digging and KNOCKBACK RESISTANCE.
skill.aptitudes.woodcutting.desc: Levels by chopping logs. Passives: faster chopping and MAX HEALTH.
skill.aptitudes.farming.desc: Levels by harvesting. Passives: double harvest and LUCK.
skill.aptitudes.combat.desc: Levels by melee kills. Passive: more melee damage (%).
skill.aptitudes.archery.desc: Levels by projectile kills. Passive: more arrow damage.
skill.aptitudes.defense.desc: Levels by taking hits. Passives: ARMOR, TOUGHNESS and explosion resistance.
skill.aptitudes.agility.desc: Levels by sprinting. Passives: SPEED and safe fall.
skill.aptitudes.fishing.desc: Levels by catching fish. Passives: LUCK and double catch.
skill.aptitudes.enchanting.desc: Levels by enchanting at the enchanting table. Passives: level refund and max MANA.

item.aptitudes.hitscan.tooltip: Right click: instant shot (%s mana). Scales with %s level.
item.aptitudes.herb_pouch.tooltip: Right click: heals and removes poison. Scales with Herbalist level.
item.aptitudes.wrench.tooltip: Right click a directional block: rotates it 90°.
role.aptitudes.berserker.desc: Axe warrior who gets deadlier the more wounded they are. XP: hitting with axes.
role.aptitudes.mage.desc: Arcane and elemental magic: runes, space and time distortion, shields and arcane projectiles, plus fire, lightning and frost.
role.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Stealth, invisibility and backstabs. XP: hitting with the dagger.
role.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: Healing, regeneration and poisons. XP: harvesting crops, flowers and berries; using herbs.
role.aptitudes.lancer.desc: Reach and devastating charges. XP: hitting with spear or trident.
role.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: Sword master: edge, parries and ripostes. XP: hitting with swords.
node.aptitudes.tough_skin.desc: Hits push you back less and your armor holds up better. Each rank: +10% knockback resistance and +1 armor toughness.
node.aptitudes.rage.desc: You fly into a rage: you gain Strength and Speed. At rank 3, Strength II. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 8 / 10 / 12 s.
node.aptitudes.bloodlust.desc: The less health you have, the more melee damage you deal. Bonus at very low health, rank 1 / 2 / 3: up to +15 / 30 / 45%.
node.aptitudes.war_cry.desc: You let out a cry that pushes back, weakens and slows the enemies around you. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 5 / 6 / 7-block radius.
node.aptitudes.arcane_affinity.desc: You hold more mana and regain it faster. Each rank: +25 max mana and +0.5 mana per second.
node.aptitudes.fireball.desc: You fire a bolt of arcane energy (up to 24 blocks). It also hits enemies next to the target and makes the target glow. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 6 / 8 / 10.
node.aptitudes.clear_mind.desc: All your abilities recharge sooner. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: −10 / 20 / 30% cooldown.
node.aptitudes.blink.desc: You teleport forward in the direction you are looking. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: up to 8 / 10 / 12 blocks.
node.aptitudes.shadow.desc: You move faster while sneaking. From rank 2, you are also invisible while sneaking.
node.aptitudes.vanish.desc: You vanish: you gain Invisibility and Speed, and the creatures chasing you lose track of you. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 6 / 8 / 10 s.
node.aptitudes.backstab.desc: You deal more damage when you hit an enemy from behind. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: +25 / 50 / 75%.
node.aptitudes.shadow_step.desc: You teleport right behind the enemy you are looking at. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: up to 16 / 20 / 24 blocks away.
node.aptitudes.vital_sap.desc: You regain 1 health on your own from time to time. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: every 9 / 6 / 3 s.
node.aptitudes.balm.desc: You heal yourself and the players within 6 blocks, and give everyone Regeneration. Healing, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 4 / 6 / 8.
node.aptitudes.herbal_immunity.desc: You become immune to harmful effects, one more per rank. Rank 1: Poison. Rank 2: also Hunger. Rank 3: also Wither.
node.aptitudes.poison_thorns.desc: You release thorns that poison and slow the enemies around you. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 5 / 6 / 7-block radius.
node.aptitudes.engineering.desc: You reach blocks from farther away, break them faster and are better protected. Each rank: +1 block of reach, +10% break speed and +1 armor.
node.aptitudes.turret.desc: You deploy an iron golem that fights for you. It drops no iron when it dies. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: lasts 20 / 25 / 30 s.
node.aptitudes.battery.desc: You hold more mana, regain it faster, jump higher and survive longer falls. Each rank: +25 max mana, +0.5 mana per second and +2 blocks of fall without damage.
node.aptitudes.thrusters.desc: You boost yourself forward and upward, then fall slowly for a moment.
node.aptitudes.reach.desc: You hit enemies from farther away. Each rank: +0.5 blocks of attack reach.
node.aptitudes.lunge.desc: You dash forward and hit every enemy in your way. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 6 / 8 / 10.
node.aptitudes.charge.desc: Your attacks deal more damage while you are sprinting. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: +15 / 30 / 45%.
node.aptitudes.sweep.desc: You strike in a circle and hit every enemy around you. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 5 / 7 / 9.
node.aptitudes.keen_edge.desc: You deal more damage with swords. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: +7 / 14 / 21%.
node.aptitudes.blade_dance.desc: You attack and move faster: you gain Haste and Speed. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: Haste I / II / III for 8 / 10 / 12 s.
node.aptitudes.parry.desc: You have a chance to completely block a melee hit. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 5 / 10 / 15%.
node.aptitudes.riposte.desc: You get ready to counter: the next hit you take does nothing and you send it back to the attacker, stronger. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: ready for 2 / 3 / 4 s, returns 150 / 200 / 250% of the damage.

item.aptitudes.oak_staff.tooltip: Right click a block: fertilizes a 3×3 area (%s mana).
item.aptitudes.guild_seal.tooltip: Right click a villager: restocks its trades (Merchant only, 5 min cooldown).

role.aptitudes.engineer.desc: Practical and advanced tech combined: reach, plating, batteries, thrusters and turrets. XP: redstone, machines, wrench and plasma gun.
role.aptitudes.paladin.desc: Holy warrior: punishes the undead and protects allies. XP: holy hammer, damaging undead, blocking with a shield.
role.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Summons allied minions that grow with your level and drains life. Evolving unlocks blood arts: pay abilities with health, make enemies bleed and, as Crimson Progenitor, cheat death. XP: tome, drain and minion damage.
role.aptitudes.druid.desc: Forest guardian: growth, roots and bear form. XP: planting saplings, breeding animals, using the staff.
role.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Trade and cunning: discounts, extra profit and bribes. XP: trading with villagers.
role.aptitudes.monk.desc: Unarmed martial arts: iron fists, evasion and meditation. XP: hitting bare-handed.
role.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Masters up to 3 of 9 elements (at levels 1, 10 and 20). Abilities change with the active element (G key).
node.aptitudes.holy_smite.desc: You deal more damage to undead (zombies, skeletons and the like). Rank 1 / 2 / 3: +20 / 40 / 60%.
node.aptitudes.divine_shield.desc: You surround yourself with a shield: Absorption for 8 s and Resistance. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: Absorption I / II / III and Resistance for 4 / 5 / 6 s.
node.aptitudes.protective_aura.desc: You and the players near you gain Resistance. At rank 3, also Regeneration. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 4 / 6 / 8-block radius.
node.aptitudes.judgement.desc: You damage the enemies near you (double against undead) and heal your allies. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 6 / 8 / 10.
node.aptitudes.dark_pact.desc: Every creature that dies within 16 blocks of you gives you mana and 1 health. Mana, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 2 / 4 / 6.
node.aptitudes.raise_minions.desc: You raise undead that fight for you for 45 s (4 at most at once). They get more health, damage and armor as you level up. Rank 1: 1 zombie. Rank 2: 1 zombie and 1 skeleton. Rank 3: 2 zombies and 1 skeleton.
node.aptitudes.life_drain.desc: You heal for part of the damage that you and your minions deal. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 5 / 10 / 15%.
node.aptitudes.death_touch.desc: You drain the life of the enemies within 5 blocks: they take damage and Wither, and you heal half of the total. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 4 / 5 / 6.
node.aptitudes.forest_child.desc: While you are in a forest, jungle or taiga, you gain Speed. From rank 2, also Regeneration; at rank 3, also Strength.
node.aptitudes.entangling_roots.desc: Roots grab the enemies around you: they can’t move and are weakened. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 6 / 7 / 8-block radius for 3 / 4 / 5 s.
node.aptitudes.growth.desc: Every 2 s, crops and saplings near you grow on their own. Higher ranks reach farther and grow them more often.
node.aptitudes.bear_form.desc: You turn into a bear: you heal when you transform and gain Strength, Resistance and extra health, but you move slower. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 10 / 12 / 14 s.
node.aptitudes.haggling.desc: Villagers give you discounts all the time, as if you had Hero of the Village. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: level I / II / III.
node.aptitudes.appraiser_eye.desc: You gain Luck for 60 s and reveal the creatures around you for 10 s. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: Luck I / II / III.
node.aptitudes.deep_pockets.desc: Each trade with a villager may give you an extra emerald. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 10 / 20 / 30% chance.
node.aptitudes.bribe.desc: You pay 1 emerald and the nearby enemies stop attacking players for a while. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 8 / 10 / 12-block radius for 7 / 9 / 11 s.
node.aptitudes.iron_fists.desc: Your punches hurt more when your hand is empty. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: +1.5 / 3 / 4.5 damage.
node.aptitudes.chi_palm.desc: You strike with your palm up to 5 blocks away and knock the enemy far back. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 6 / 8 / 10.
node.aptitudes.evasion.desc: You have a chance to avoid any attack from a creature. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 7 / 14 / 21%.
node.aptitudes.meditation.desc: You meditate for 4 s without moving: you gain Regeneration III and Resistance II and recover mana. It costs no mana. Mana, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 30 / 40 / 50.
node.aptitudes.elemental_affinity.desc: Turns on the passive bonus of your active element. The higher the rank, the stronger it is.
node.aptitudes.elemental_bolt.desc: You fire a bolt (up to 24 blocks) that applies the effect of your active element. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 6 / 7 / 8.
node.aptitudes.elemental_dominion.desc: The passive bonuses of the other elements you have mastered are also active, at this node’s rank.
node.aptitudes.elemental_burst.desc: You unleash a blast around you with the effect of your active element. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 5 / 6 / 7-block radius.
element.aptitudes.ice.desc: Slows and freezes. Passive: immune to freezing (powder snow).
element.aptitudes.lightning.desc: Chain damage and lightning. Passive: +3% speed per rank.
element.aptitudes.earth.desc: Launches enemies into the air. Passive: +1 armor per rank.
element.aptitudes.wind.desc: Strong knockback and levitation. Passive: +3 blocks safe fall per rank.
element.aptitudes.water.desc: Healing damage and area heals. Passive: water breathing (and fast swimming from rank 2).
element.aptitudes.plant.desc: Poison and roots. Passive: regenerate on dirt, grass or leaves.
element.aptitudes.magma.desc: Heavy fire damage with knockback. Passive: immune to magma blocks, +1 toughness per rank.
element.aptitudes.shadow.desc: Wither, blindness and invisibility. Passive: night vision in the dark.
aptitudes.element.not_elementalist: Elementalist must be your primary or secondary role.
aptitudes.element.no_slot: You can't master another element yet (levels 1, 10 and 20).
ultimate.aptitudes.berserker.desc: 8 s unable to die (health never drops below 1), with Strength II, Speed II and Resistance.
ultimate.aptitudes.mage.desc: A black hole at the target point pulls and damages enemies for 5 s.
ultimate.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Leap behind up to 5 nearby enemies; those below 30% health die instantly.
ultimate.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: 8-block zone for 10 s: allies regenerate and are cleansed; enemies are poisoned.
ultimate.aptitudes.engineer.desc: 12 impacts in 3 s around the target point. They don't break blocks and only hurt and knock back enemies.
ultimate.aptitudes.lancer.desc: Huge leap and dive with a devastating shockwave.
ultimate.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: 15 slashes in 3 s on the nearest enemy, ignoring hit invulnerability.
ultimate.aptitudes.paladin.desc: 8-block zone for 8 s: allies cannot die and undead burn.
ultimate.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Drains enemies within 10 blocks, heals you, fills your minion army and enrages it.
ultimate.aptitudes.druid.desc: Summons 3 allied spirit wolves (30 s) and roots nearby enemies.
ultimate.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Roulette: jackpot, power, full heal, gold rain, curse on enemies… or the house wins.
ultimate.aptitudes.monk.desc: 10 s untouchable by creatures, with Speed III, Strength II and Jump Boost.
ultimate.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Unleash the burst of all your mastered elements at once.

aptitudes.blood.immortality: Crimson Immortality! Blood denies you death.
aptitudes.casino.jackpot: 🎰 JACKPOT! Emeralds, Luck and Hero of the Village.
aptitudes.casino.curse: 🎰 Bad luck falls upon your enemies.
category.aptitudes.martial.desc: Melee combat: Berserker, Lancer, Swordsman and Monk.
category.aptitudes.arcane.desc: Magic and dark powers: Mage, Necromancer and Elementalist.
category.aptitudes.shadow.desc: Stealth and deception: Assassin and Shapeshifter.
category.aptitudes.guardian.desc: Protection and life: Herbalist, Paladin and Druid.
category.aptitudes.craft.desc: Ingenuity and trade: Engineer and Merchant.
role.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Turns into mobs (unlocked by defeating them) and uses their powers. Other players see you as the mob. XP: using transformations and powers.
ultimate.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Become a Warden for 20 s: +20 health, Strength II, Resistance II, Darkness to nearby players and Sonic Boom as your power.
node.aptitudes.mimicry.desc: Staying transformed drains less mana per second. Mana per second, base / rank 1 / 2 / 3: 3 / 2.5 / 2 / 1.5.
node.aptitudes.transform.desc: You turn into the form you chose, or back into a human. Other players see you as that creature, but your hitbox stays the same.
node.aptitudes.trickster.desc: Rank 1: monsters ignore you while you look like one of them. Rank 2: you also make the creature’s sounds, and other players hear them.
node.aptitudes.form_power.desc: You use the power of your current form: Creeper explodes, Enderman teleports, Spider bites with venom, Blaze throws fireballs, Bat flies, Slime super-jumps, Chicken fires eggs, Golem slams the ground, Witch curses and Villager flees.
form.aptitudes.creeper.desc: Power: explode without dying (breaks blocks if the server allows). Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.enderman.desc: Night vision. Power: 20-28 block teleport. Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.spider.desc: Night vision. Power: venom bite. Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.blaze.desc: Fire resistance. Power: 3 fireballs. Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.bat.desc: Night vision; slow fall while sneaking. Power: short flight steered by looking. Unlock: defeat 5.
form.aptitudes.slime.desc: No fall damage. Power: super jump. Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.chicken.desc: Slow fall. Power: egg barrage (troll). Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.iron_golem.desc: Resistance, but slower. Power: ground slam. Unlock: defeat 3.
form.aptitudes.witch.desc: Poison immune. Power: curse (poison, slowness, weakness). Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.villager.desc: Perfect troll disguise. Power: escape (Speed III). Unlock: Shapeshifter level 5.
item.aptitudes.mimic_mask.tooltip: Right click: transform / return to human form (Shapeshifter).
item.aptitudes.mimic_mask.not_shapeshift: You need the Shapeshifter role active.
aptitudes.morph.locked: You haven't unlocked the %s form yet.
aptitudes.morph.exhausted: Out of mana: you return to human form.
signature.aptitudes.berserker.desc: Mobs within 8 blocks lose HALF their current health; you gain Strength III and Speed II (15 s).
signature.aptitudes.mage.desc: 8 arcane runes fall on the target point: area magic damage and knockback. No fire or explosions.
signature.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Marks the target: it takes TRIPLE damage from you for 10 s.
signature.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: Cleanses nearby allies and grants Regeneration III and extra health.
signature.aptitudes.engineer.desc: 1st use: sets a teleport point. 2nd use: return to it with plating (Absorption IV + Resistance II).
signature.aptitudes.lancer.desc: 3 s of continuous charges that trample enemies; untouchable by creatures meanwhile.
signature.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: A 14-block slash through every enemy: 20 damage.
signature.aptitudes.paladin.desc: 10 s taking NO damage at all, +50 mana, Health Boost III, Absorption III, Resistance II and a full heal.
signature.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Raises 4 minions with Strength II and Resistance II. Passive (Master): your minions are sturdier and their damage heals you.
signature.aptitudes.druid.desc: When you die, you revive as with a Totem of Undying. Once every 5 minutes.
signature.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Permanent Hero of the Village V (huge discounts) and Luck.
signature.aptitudes.monk.desc: Fully heals allies within 10 blocks and grants Strength II, Speed II, Resistance II and Regeneration II (20 s).
signature.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Raises a wall of your main element and unleashes its domain for 10 s, damaging every enemy inside.
signature.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Troll: turns nearby players into chickens for 10 s and levitates monsters.
aptitudes.ability.no_signature: You need a Master-tier role (with an active signature) to use Z.
aptitudes.signature.beacon_set: Beacon set. Use the ability again to return here.
aptitudes.signature.forest_rebirth: The forest brings you back to life!
unique.aptitudes.adaptation.desc: Passive: each hit of the same damage type makes you 10% more resistant to it for 60 s (max 80%). Active: 10 s immunity to the last damage type taken and Regeneration II.
unique.aptitudes.greed.desc: Passive: 15% extra emerald on kills. Active: steals every beneficial effect from anyone within 8 blocks.
unique.aptitudes.void_archive.desc: Passive: memorizes the last role ability used near you (16 blocks) by any player. Active: you cast it yourself at rank 3.
unique.aptitudes.fungal.desc: Passive: your hits infect (poison) and it spreads on death. Active: 6 s spore cloud (poison II, blindness).
unique.aptitudes.parasite.desc: Passive: 10% lifesteal. Active: latch onto a target, draining 2 health per second for 5 s while invisible.
unique.aptitudes.hellfire.desc: Passive: fire immune; your hits burn. Active: infernal nova (10 area damage and ground fire).
unique.aptitudes.chosen_king.desc: Passive: +4 hearts; Strength and Regeneration to allies within 12 blocks. Active: Royal Decree (enemies within 16 blocks are nearly frozen and weakened).
unique.aptitudes.chosen_king.condition: Defeat the Wither and the Dragon: %s/%s
unique.aptitudes.spacetime.desc: Passive: your position and health are recorded every second. Active: rewind 5 seconds (position and health).
unique.aptitudes.negation.desc: Passive: immune to negative effects. Active: 8 s zone where other players CANNOT use abilities and mobs lose their effects.
unique.aptitudes.geneticist.desc: Passive: nearby babies grow 10× faster. Active: mutates nearby animals into other species.
unique.aptitudes.mirror.desc: Active: copy the mob you look at (any mob): become it for 30 s and gain half its max health.
unique.aptitudes.exploiter.desc: Passive: 25% double ore. Active: 15 s of double loot from creatures you kill and Luck III.
unique.aptitudes.pendragon.desc: Passive: with a sword, +4 armor and +10% damage. Active: Excalibur, a 30-block beam of light (16 damage, double vs undead).
unique.aptitudes.sky_lord.desc: Passive: immune to fall damage. Active: 12 s of free flight.
unique.aptitudes.stillness.desc: Passive: Resistance while crouching still. Active: stops time for 5 s within 12 blocks (mobs and projectiles frozen).
unique.aptitudes.harbinger.desc: Passive: undead won't attack you. Active: sentence a target; after 3 s it loses 50% of its max health (10% for bosses).

node.aptitudes.whirlwind.desc: You spin 3 times in 1.5 s, hitting everything around you on each spin. Damage per spin, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 3 / 4 / 5.

node.aptitudes.arcane_missiles.desc: You fire missiles that chase the nearest enemies, 3 damage each. Missiles, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 4 / 5 / 6.
node.aptitudes.lethal_tempo.desc: Your 3rd hit in a row on the same target is a finisher: it deals extra damage and applies Wither. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: +50 / 75 / 100%%.

node.aptitudes.vanish_on_kill.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, you gain Speed for 3 s and turn invisible for a moment. Invisibility, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 1 / 2 / 3 s.
node.aptitudes.fan_of_knives.desc: You throw blades at every enemy within 5 blocks; they take damage and Poison. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 4 / 5 / 6.
node.aptitudes.shuriken.desc: You throw a shuriken at range: the target takes damage, glows and gets Slowness II. Damage, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 7 / 9 / 11.
node.aptitudes.bloom.desc: If you stay still for 3 s, you and the allies near you gain Regeneration. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 3 / 4 / 5-block radius.
node.aptitudes.antidote.desc: Every second you have a chance to remove one harmful effect from yourself. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: 15 / 30 / 45%%.

node.aptitudes.spore_cloud.desc: You create a cloud of spores for 6 s where you are looking; enemies inside get Poison and Weakness.

node.aptitudes.auto_shield.desc: When a hit deals 5 or more damage, you gain Absorption for 5 s. Once every 20 s. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: Absorption I / II / III.
node.aptitudes.field_repair.desc: Every 20 s you repair all the gear you are wearing and holding. Durability, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 2 / 4 / 6.
node.aptitudes.grapple.desc: You pull yourself to the block you are looking at, with no fall damage. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: up to 20 / 24 / 28 blocks.

node.aptitudes.impetus.desc: Sprinting for 2 s charges your next hit: it deals extra damage and pushes the enemy. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: +30 / 45 / 60%%.
node.aptitudes.brace.desc: While you are sneaking, you take less damage. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: −10 / 20 / 30%%.
node.aptitudes.dragoon_fall.desc: You take less fall damage. Rank 1 / 2 / 3: −30 / 60 / 90%%.

node.aptitudes.thousand_cuts.desc: You hit the target with 5 quick cuts. Damage per cut, rank 1 / 2 / 3: 3 / 4 / 5.

node.aptitudes.monk_legend.desc: Always on: you gain Resistance while you sneak without moving. When activated (H key): you stop time for 5 s within 12 blocks: creatures and projectiles freeze.

guide.aptitudes.start.title: Welcome
guide.aptitudes.start.body:
Aptitudes is a full RPG system: your SKILLS level up by doing things (mining, chopping, fighting…), your ATTRIBUTES are bought at a Bonfire with experience, and you pick a primary and a secondary ROLE, each with its own talent tree, mana and abilities.

First steps:
1. Craft a Bonfire at the Guild Desk and rest.
2. Press J and choose your primary role.
3. Spend tree points (J) and equip your actives.
4. Use V, B (primary role) and N, M (secondary).
guide.aptitudes.keys.title: Keys
guide.aptitudes.keys.body:
K: attributes and skills.
J: roles and talent tree.
V / B: primary role actives.
N / M: secondary role actives.
Z: signature ability (Master).
R: ultimate (Ultimate tier).
H: legendary ability.
G: switch element (Elementalist).
Y: accessories.
O: toggle the HUD; Shift + O: HUD settings.
In the tree: drag to move, wheel to zoom, C to center. If the window does not fit (large GUI scale), use the wheel outside the tree or PgUp/PgDn to scroll it.
In the grimoire: ↑/↓ change chapter; click an item to see its recipe; Backspace or the mouse side button go back; ←/→ switch recipe.
U (in an inventory, over an Aptitudes item): open its page in the grimoire. Tabs at the top: Bestiary, Progress, Search and Bookmarks (☆ on any page).
All can be changed in Options → Controls.
guide.aptitudes.bonfire.title: The Bonfire
guide.aptitudes.bonfire.body:
Recipe: iron sword on top and, below, cobblestone + campfire + cobblestone.

Resting (right-click): restores all health and mana, sets your respawn point, refills your Estus and Ether Flasks and opens the level-up screen.

Leveling up: missing attribute points are bought as soul levels paying regular experience levels. Each soul level costs 1 + level/6 XP levels (max 10) and every 3 soul levels grant 1 point.

XP bloodstain: when you die, your XP stays where you died (soul flames only you can see). Go back for it before dying again.

Ritual: use a Rebirth Offering on the Bonfire to be able to change one of your roles.
guide.aptitudes.attributes.title: Attributes
guide.aptitudes.attributes.body:
Eight Souls-like attributes (K screen):
Vigor: max health.
Mind: max mana and regeneration.
Endurance: armor.
Strength: melee damage.
Dexterity: attack speed.
Intelligence: magic damage.
Faith: lower cooldown on every ability (global cap 60%%).
Luck: loot and chances.

Each role has 2 affine attributes (★): +50%% value if it is your primary role, +25%% if secondary.
guide.aptitudes.skills.title: Skills by use
guide.aptitudes.skills.body:
They level up as you play: Mining, Excavation, Woodcutting, Farming, Combat, Archery, Defense, Agility, Fishing and Enchanting.

Each level gives a small passive bonus (mining speed, armor, arrow damage…). Every 10 levels you unlock a MILESTONE: night vision while mining, auto-replanting, felling whole trees, piercing arrows, a second chance on death… Hover each skill on the K screen to see them.

Repeating the SAME source too often (the same mob type, the same attacker, fishing nonstop) gives less and less XP: mob farms and AFK fishing are not efficient. Normal play is not affected.

COMBOS: chained melee hits on creatures (within 2.5 s) add +3%% damage each (max +15%%). At 5 hits, your next hit is a FINISHER based on your main role's category: seismic strike (martial), execution (shadow), arcane chain (arcane), holy strike that heals (guardian) or electric overload (craft). Taking a heavy hit breaks the combo.
guide.aptitudes.roles.title: Roles
guide.aptitudes.roles.body:
There are 20 roles in 5 categories (Martial, Arcane, Shadow, Guardian, Craft). You pick a PRIMARY and a SECONDARY role (J screen); the secondary gains XP at half rate.

Each role has its signature item (using it grants XP), its own resource (Fury, Focus, Harmony…; at 50%% it empowers the next ability), an armor set and a unique mechanic.

Synergy: two roles of the same category give +15%% role XP; different categories give +15 mana.

Filling an empty slot is free. To REPLACE a chosen role you need the Bonfire ritual with a Rebirth Offering.
guide.aptitudes.tree.title: Talent tree
guide.aptitudes.tree.body:
Each role’s tree combines base nodes, a legendary node, evolution rows and deeper paths:
• Passives on the left, Paths in the center and Actives on the right.
• Each node requires at least one rank in its prerequisite; the lines show the route.
• Three exclusive paths: follow only ONE per role. The «Paths» button shows all seven steps, the level 32 fork and the level 50 keystone. See «Paths and keystones».
• Four base actives and four more from evolution: equip two per role with Slot 1 / Slot 2.
• Reactives: passives triggered by taking damage, kills or other actions.
• Legendary: level 25 node, activated with H.

Default POINTS: 1 at level 1 and 3 every 3 role levels; 51 at level 50. Master adds 10 and Ultimate adds 5: up to 66. You cannot learn everything.

EVOLUTION ROWS: Master opens five nodes (three passives and two actives, up to two ranks); Ultimate opens another five (one rank). They remain locked at the bottom of the tree until you evolve.
guide.aptitudes.evolution.title: Evolution
guide.aptitudes.evolution.body:
Each role can evolve twice:
• MASTER: level 20, complete the role trial (kills with its weapon, ability uses…) and a Mastery Emblem. Unlocks the signature ability (Z), +1 rank on its nodes and a new weapon.
• ULTIMATE: level 30, having slain a boss (Wither, Dragon or Warden) with the role active and an Ultimate Core. Unlocks the ultimate (R), another extra rank and the ultimate weapon.

The Evolve button is on the J screen (its tooltip shows what is missing).
guide.aptitudes.weapons.title: Evolution weapons
guide.aptitudes.weapons.body:
When you evolve to Master and to Ultimate you receive a new weapon for your role. They appear in the top row of the tree, beside the signature and the ultimate.

• Melee roles: a blade (diamond at Master, netherite at Ultimate) that, with the role active, leaves a sweep in its color, charges the role resource and, the ultimate one, heals you a little.
• Magic or ranged roles: an instant-shot focus (7 or 10 damage + 0.2 per role level) that costs mana.

If you lose it, select it in the tree and press Claim (only if it is not already in your inventory or Ender chest).
guide.aptitudes.elements.title: Elementalist
guide.aptitudes.elements.body:
The Elementalist masters up to 3 elements (at level 1, 10 and 20) out of 14: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Plant, Magma, Shadow, Light, Void, Poison, Crystal and Sound. The choice is permanent. G switches the active element.

FUSIONS: if you master both elements of a pair and cast Elemental Burst with one of them active, the fusion is added:
Fire+Wind: Firestorm · Water+Lightning: Electrocution · Ice+Water: Blizzard · Earth+Magma: Eruption · Plant+Poison: Plague · Light+Shadow: Eclipse · Void+Crystal: Crystal Singularity · Sound+Wind: Resonance · Lightning+Crystal: Prism · Fire+Ice: Thermal Shock.
In the element view (J → Elements) each element lists its fusions.
guide.aptitudes.armor.title: Role armor
guide.aptitudes.armor.body:
Each role has a 4-piece set. Crafted ONLY at the GUILD DESK (right-click it): the normal piece pattern made with the role MATERIAL and a Soul Shard in the center slot.

With all 4 pieces on and that role as primary or secondary, the set bonus activates (see each piece's tooltip). Weight changes defense: heavy (Berserker, Lancer, Paladin), medium and light.

They also appear in tower and camp chests, can be bought with Armory Vouchers from the guild villager and drop from champions.
guide.aptitudes.soul_items.title: Soul items
guide.aptitudes.soul_items.body:
Soul Shard: basic material. Dropped by monsters (see Loot).
Estus Flask: 5 charges; heals 8 health.
Ether Flask: 5 charges; restores 40%% mana.
(Flasks refill when you rest at the Bonfire.)
Soul tools (diamond tool + 3 shards): pickaxe and shovel break 3×3 while sneaking; the axe fells the whole tree while sneaking; the hoe harvests and replants 3×3.
Rebirth Offering: lets you change a role (Bonfire ritual).
Armory Voucher: gives a piece of your primary role's set.
guide.aptitudes.accessories.title: Accessories
guide.aptitudes.accessories.body:
Y key: 2 ring slots and 1 amulet slot. Kept on death.
Rings: Strength (+1.5 damage), Vitality (+4 health), Swiftness (+8%% speed), Mana (+30), Vampire (5%% lifesteal), Fortune (+2 luck).
Amulets: Guardian (+3 armor), Phoenix (saves you from death every 10 min), Arcane (−10%% cooldowns), Grove (heal out of combat), Hunter's Trophy (+25%% damage to elites).

Recipes: ring = 4 gold nuggets + gem + Elite Essence. Amulet = string + Elite Essence + gem (the Phoenix one needs a Champion Heart).
guide.aptitudes.elites.title: Elites and champions
guide.aptitudes.elites.body:
5%% of monsters spawn as ELITES (visible name, double health and 1-2 modifiers: Swift, Armored, Vampiric, Brutal, Regenerating, Explosive, Frost, Blinking, Giant).

Some elites are CHAMPIONS (3 modifiers, 4 times the health and a boss bar). Every tower has a skeleton champion on its rooftop.

They drop Soul Shards, Elite Essence and, champions, a Champion Heart and a role armor piece.
guide.aptitudes.structures.title: Structures
guide.aptitudes.structures.body:
RUINED TOWER: 4 floors with chests, monster spawners and a champion on the rooftop next to the best chest (role armor, soul tools, accessories).
BONFIRE SHRINE: ruins with a lit Bonfire and a chest (shards, flasks, sometimes an Offering).
CAMP: hunters, warlocks or bandits, with guards and themed loot.

They only generate in new terrain (unexplored chunks).

Sealed Temples (15×15, stone, deepslate or blackstone depending on the Threat ring): copy with the levers the lights above the sealed door; from ring II, also step on the plates in the order of their candles. The door opens and the temple guardian awakens; its key opens the Reliquary, which gives each player one Life Vessel (+1 permanent heart, up to 5).
guide.aptitudes.guild.title: Guild villager
guide.aptitudes.guild.body:
Place a Guild Desk next to a jobless villager to make it a Guildmaster.

Depending on its level it sells: Soul Shards, Estus and Ether Flasks, role materials, Armory Vouchers, Rebirth Offerings, Mastery Emblems and Ultimate Cores. It buys leather and bones.

Make the Desk at a crafting table. Use the Desk for the other Aptitudes recipes.

RUNES: hold a role weapon in one hand and a rune in the other and use the Guild Desk to socket it (two per weapon, different ones). There are Flame, Leech, Swift, Force, Frost, Thunder, Guard and the Eclipse rune. To remove the last rune: Shift + right-click the Desk with the weapon in hand and the other hand empty; it costs emeralds and the rune is lost.
guide.aptitudes.recipes.title: Recipes
guide.aptitudes.recipes.body:
Bonfire: iron sword / cobblestone + campfire + cobblestone.
Grimoire: book + gold nugget.
Rebirth Offering: 3 Soul Shards + gold ingot + candle.
Estus Flask: bottle + 2 shards + blaze powder + gold ingot.
Ether Flask: bottle + 2 shards + lapis lazuli + amethyst shard.
Soul tool: diamond tool + 3 shards.
Role armor: piece pattern with the role material + a shard in the center.
Mastery Emblem: gold, diamonds and an emerald block.
Ultimate Core: echo shards, dragon's breath, diamond blocks and a nether star.
Soul Shard: 1 echo shard → 2.
Guild Desk: 2 gold + emerald + 5 planks.
Accessories: see the Accessories chapter.
The game's recipe book shows all the others.
guide.aptitudes.drops.title: Loot
guide.aptitudes.drops.body:
Soul Shard: 5%% of monsters killed by a player (+1%% per luck point); 4 from each boss (Wither, Dragon, Warden, Elder Guardian).
Elites: 1-2 shards, Elite Essence (50%%) and more XP.
Champions: 4-6 shards, Champion Heart, 2-3 Essences and a role armor piece.
Tower, shrine and camp chests: shards, flasks, role items, armor, soul tools, accessories, Offerings and Emblems.
Guild villager: almost all of the above for emeralds.

guide.aptitudes.paths.title: Paths and keystones
guide.aptitudes.paths.body:
Each role has three paths: A, B and C. Learning the first rank chooses ONE and locks the other two. Reset the tree to change paths.

In J, the «Paths» button opens the selected role’s full path view: A/B/C tabs, levels, requirements and confirmation when choosing. S1–S3 also appear in the tree grid.

SEVEN STEPS (default levels):
S1: 10; S2: 14; S3: 20; S4: 26.
S5: level 32, a fork between S5x/S5y: you may learn only ONE branch.
S6: level 40; requires either S5 branch and repeats S4’s effect at ×1.5 strength.
S7: keystone, level 50, a single rank; requires S6.
S1–S6 allow three ranks, each requiring five more levels. Each rank costs one point.

KEYSTONES: every path has one of these ten templates. Learning S7 activates it in your primary or secondary role, with an indicator on the HUD. Default values below; the server can change them:

Carnage: on kill, restore 10%% of your maximum health and gain Haste II for 5 s.

Bulwark: below 30%% health, gain Absorption II (8 points) and Resistance I for 6 s; 60 s cooldown.

Tempest: critical hits and 15%% of direct hits send a 3-damage spark to another enemy within 5 blocks; 1 s cooldown.

Overload: every fourth ability costs no mana and has half its normal cooldown.

Specter: +5%% dodge; after dodging, your next hit within 3 s is a guaranteed critical.

Detonation: on kill, deal 4 magic damage to enemies within 3 blocks; no chain detonations, block damage or harm to allies.

Contagion: on kill, spread the victim’s poison, slowness, wither and fire to 2 enemies within 4 blocks.

Sanctuary: every 5 s, heal yourself and allies within 8 blocks for 2 health points.

Fortune: on kill, a 25%% chance of an extra loot roll; elites also have a 10%% chance to drop an emerald.

Legion: +1 maximum minion; your minions heal you for 10%% of the damage they deal.

In the Paths chapter of the grimoire, click a role to see its three paths with their icons, levels and keystone.
guide.aptitudes.achievements.title: Achievements
guide.aptitudes.achievements.body:
Open Minecraft’s advancements and select the «Aptitudes» tab. It contains 17 achievements, automatically granted by the server when their requirements are met. Hover over an advancement to read its objective.

BONFIRE AND PROGRESSION:
Rest at a Bonfire; reach soul level 10; choose a role; evolve to Master and then Ultimate; reach level 50 in a usage skill.

COMBAT AND EQUIPMENT:
Perform a combo finisher; socket a rune; defeat a custom boss and the Eclipse Herald. The hit following a chain of five hits performs the finisher.

EVENTS:
Complete a Soul Fog, an Ember Rain and an Eclipse; each event has its own achievement. For the Eclipse, reach the end without dying.

PARTIES AND GUILD:
Form or join a party; claim your first contract; claim 10 contracts; reach Guild Master (700 reputation). Accepting a contract does not count as claiming it.

On joining, the server checks achievements based on saved state: role, evolution, soul level, skills and contracts. Older worlds can grant these without repeating that progress. Action achievements require performing the action; achievements already granted are not duplicated.
guide.aptitudes.eclipse.title: World events
guide.aptitudes.eclipse.body:
By default, every 10 days from day 10 the Overworld picks a random event: Eclipse, Soul Fog or Ember Rain. It never repeats the previous one. The bell the evening before announces which is coming; /aptitudes event shows the next event.

ECLIPSE:
Penumbra, 6:00–9:00: red sky and first waves.
Totality, 9:00–15:00: crimson ring, ash, more elites and champions. At 12:00 the Herald arrives near each group of players.
Retreat, 15:00–18:00: waves stop.

Creatures have more health, damage and, by default, +4 armour. They may wear chainmail in Penumbra, iron in Totality and diamond if they are champions. Totality adds another 25%% health and damage, and wither skeletons join the waves. Creatures dissolve when the event ends.

Elites, champions and the Herald drop Eclipse Fragments. The Herald drops the Eclipse Core, which upgrades evolution weapons at the Guild Desk. The Eclipse Rune defaults to +15%% damage against elites and bosses. Reaching the end without dying grants role and Combat XP.

SOUL FOG (18:00–6:00): grey fog and only undead: zombies, skeletons and their variants. Depending on the biome, drowned and bogged appear near water, husks in warm climates or strays in cold ones. They drop Soul Shards; no phantoms appear.

EMBER RAIN (6:00–18:00): small, large and huge meteors, visible before impact. Larger meteors have stronger explosions and more loot. They do not break blocks but can deal damage. They leave minerals and sometimes diamonds or netherite scrap; large and huge meteors also leave magma for 30 s. They may bring magma cubes, blazes, piglin brutes, hoglins and wither skeletons.

Values depend on the server configuration. Turn off the red sky in HUD settings (Shift + O).

ASSAULT: defaults are 4 creatures per player in Penumbra and 8 in Totality every 30 s. When space and budget permit, each wave opens with an elite; Totality also brings a champion. Zero chance disables the matching guarantee. Elite units are zombies or skeletons in full armor; champions wear diamond. Their equipment never drops. Limits: 12 creatures per nearby player, 24 per zone and 128 loaded worldwide, including Heralds; these may replace an ordinary unit at the cap. Values are configurable.

guide.aptitudes.contracts.title: Guild Contracts
guide.aptitudes.contracts.body:
Place a CONTRACT BOARD and use it. Each Minecraft day offers you 3 contracts fixed for you (closing and reopening doesn't change them); the first offer is always of the highest difficulty you have.

You can carry 2 contracts at once (3 from Veteran). Each offer can only be accepted once per day. Contracts in progress don't expire.

TYPES: Hunt (your party's kills count too), Delivery (all at once, from your inventory), Fishing, Enchanting, Profession (XP in a skill), Forge (at the Guild Desk), Event (survive an Eclipse, Soul Fog or Ember Rain) and Boss (Legendary only; your party counts too).

DIFFICULTY: rises with reputation (Apprentice → Officer 100 → Veteran 300 → Master 700). With your primary role at Master, Elite contracts appear; at Ultimate, Legendary ones.

REWARDS: emeralds, primary role XP, reputation and, for the hardest, Soul Shards, armory vouchers or mastery emblems.

guide.aptitudes.alchemy.title: Alchemy
guide.aptitudes.alchemy.body:
Brew in a fueled brewing stand. The recipes below come from the game; hover over bottles and click the petals to view their extraction.

Mana restores energy; Frenzy speeds up attacks; Veil protects against event creatures; Vigor regenerates and nourishes.

A primary or secondary Herbalist within 8 blocks brews 50% faster and extends effects by 50%. Opening the stand lets them move up to 32 blocks away while online in that world. Doses do not add potency.

Only one Herbalist earns XP per batch: the player who opened the stand takes priority, then the nearest. The first three grant 4 base XP; repeated batches within five minutes reduce XP to zero. Taking bottles or reopening never pays again. Creative and spectator players do not qualify. These values are configurable.

bestiary.aptitudes.spider.tip: Climbs walls and leaps at you. Neutral in bright light, hostile in darkness; low ceilings stop its jumps.
bestiary.aptitudes.cave_spider.tip: Small spider of abandoned mineshafts whose bite poisons. Break or light up its spawner and fight it in narrow tunnels.
bestiary.aptitudes.creeper.tip: Silent stalker that explodes at close range. Hit it and step back to cancel the fuse; one charged by lightning explodes far harder.
bestiary.aptitudes.enderman.tip: Neutral until you look into its eyes or strike it. It teleports, dodges projectiles and is hurt by water: fight it under a two-block-high roof.
bestiary.aptitudes.witch.tip: Throws harmful potions and drinks healing or resistance when hurt. Rush it down and keep milk to cleanse its effects.
bestiary.aptitudes.slime.tip: Splits into smaller slimes when slain; the tiniest ones are harmless. Found in swamps and in certain deep areas.
bestiary.aptitudes.phantom.tip: Haunts players who have not slept for days, diving from the sky at night. Sleep to keep it away, or strike as it swoops.
bestiary.aptitudes.silverfish.tip: Hides in infested stone and swarms out when disturbed, calling others. In strongholds, be wary of suspicious stone.
bestiary.aptitudes.pillager.tip: Crossbow raider that patrols in groups and leads raids. Take cover between volleys and strike while it reloads.
bestiary.aptitudes.vindicator.tip: Axe-wielding raider that deals heavy melee damage. Keep it at bay with a shield or ranged attacks.
bestiary.aptitudes.evoker.tip: Spellcaster that raises lines of fangs from the ground and summons spirits. Defeat it quickly to stop the summons.
bestiary.aptitudes.ravager.tip: Raid beast that charges and roars, knocking everything back. Strike from the sides and block its bites with a shield to stun it.
bestiary.aptitudes.guardian.tip: Ocean monument sentry that charges a laser beam. Break its line of sight with blocks and mind its spikes when you attack.
bestiary.aptitudes.elder_guardian.tip: Ancient keeper of the monument. It curses nearby players with Mining Fatigue; bring Water Breathing and good armor.
bestiary.aptitudes.breeze.tip: Elusive wind spirit of the trial chambers. It leaps around and fires wind charges that push you back, and it deflects projectiles.
bestiary.aptitudes.warden.tip: Blind guardian of the deep dark that hunts by sound and smell. Its sonic boom pierces armor and shields. Sneak, distract it with thrown items or leave.
bestiary.aptitudes.zombified_piglin.tip: Neutral until one is attacked; then the whole group retaliates. Never strike one in a crowded area.
bestiary.aptitudes.piglin_brute.tip: Bastion guard with a golden axe, always hostile even if you wear gold. It does not respawn: clear it carefully.
bestiary.aptitudes.hoglin.tip: Charging beast of the crimson forests that tosses you into the air. It flees from warped fungi and turns into a zoglin in the Overworld.
bestiary.aptitudes.blaze.tip: Fortress spirit that hovers and fires volleys of fireballs. Fire Resistance and snowballs make it far easier.
bestiary.aptitudes.ghast.tip: Huge floating creature whose fireballs explode on impact. Hit a fireball to send it back, or shoot it with a bow.
bestiary.aptitudes.magma_cube.tip: Fiery Nether cube that splits like a slime and jumps high. The large ones hit hard: fight from higher ground.
bestiary.aptitudes.wither_skeleton.tip: Tall fortress swordsman whose blows inflict Wither. A shield and a fast weapon help; it sometimes drops its skull.
bestiary.aptitudes.endermite.tip: Tiny pest that may appear where an ender pearl lands. Endermen attack it on sight.
bestiary.aptitudes.shulker.tip: End city turret that hides in its shell and fires homing bullets that cause Levitation. Strike while its shell is open.
bestiary.aptitudes.wither.tip: Summoned three-headed horror that fires explosive skulls and resists arrows at half health. Fight it underground and bring healing.
bestiary.aptitudes.ender_dragon.tip: Ruler of the End, healed by the crystals atop the obsidian pillars. Destroy the crystals first, then strike when it perches on the portal.
bestiary.aptitudes.elite.tip: Creature empowered with one or more affixes shown in its name. It hits harder and has more health, but drops Elite Essence and soul shards.
bestiary.aptitudes.champion.tip: The strongest elite, with its own boss bar. Its affixes stack; defeating it grants a Champion's Heart and sometimes role armor.
bestiary.aptitudes.boss_tower_sentinel.t: Guardian at the top of the towers. It grows stronger in phase two; in its final phase it marks a circle around itself before striking. Step out of the mark.
bestiary.aptitudes.boss_shrine_oracle.ti: Spellcaster of the bonfire shrines. It hardens in phase two and in its final phase strikes in a ring that also slows: stay close to it, inside the ring.

The Essence That Dwells in All

Before the guilds raised their strongholds, before the masters wrote down their teachings, mortals already possessed what would later be called Essence.

It was no gift from the gods, nor a force reserved for a chosen few.

It dwelt naturally in living beings.

Some learned to strengthen their bodies. Others discovered abilities that seemed to exceed the limits of their nature. Many never understood what awakened those possibilities.

The first masters observed that constant practice transformed their apprentices' abilities.

Thus began the study of the Aptitudes.

The guilds did not create that power.

They learned to develop it.
lore.aptitudes.guild.twenty_paths.title: The Twenty Paths
lore.aptitudes.guild.twenty_paths.body:
For generations, masters passed down their techniques without belonging to a common tradition.

Each community developed different ways of fighting, surviving, building and understanding the world.

In time, great schools emerged.

Twenty of those traditions reached extraordinary influence and were recognized by the guilds of the First Era.

Their teachings were not identical.

Some championed mastery of arms; others sought to understand arcane forces, the behavior of creatures, or the possibilities of knowledge.

Yet all shared one principle: power must be cultivated through experience.

Their names survived even after their strongholds vanished.
The ancient masters discovered that a single discipline could lead to very different forms of mastery.

Those who shared an initial training began to set themselves apart as they developed their abilities.

Some preferred endurance. Others perfected precision, adaptation, or methods their companions barely understood.

The Council of the Three Ways, convened by the Concord, recognized three great doctrines for each guild.

None was declared superior.

Each demanded years of dedication and a particular understanding of the original teachings.

Choosing a path meant giving up the others: true mastery requires depth.
lore.aptitudes.chronology.council_three_: The Council of the Three Ways

In the days of the First Era's greatest prosperity, the representatives of the great guilds gathered to compare their teaching methods.

The diversity of techniques had grown so large that even masters of the same discipline argued over the right way.

The Council did not settle those differences by proclaiming victors.

It recognized that one tradition could contain several equally legitimate answers.

The doctrines were ordered, their teachings recorded, and their techniques handed down to new generations.

For a long time, that agreement allowed the guilds to share knowledge without giving up their differences.

The name of the Council outlived the institutions that convened it.
lore.aptitudes.faction.concordance.title: The Concord of the Guilds
lore.aptitudes.faction.concordance.body:
The First Era knew a time when the twenty traditions worked together under a common organization.

They called it the Concord.

Its representatives shared training methods, tools and discoveries. The routes between settlements let masters travel and let apprentices learn techniques different from those of their homeland.

The Concord never managed to eliminate every rivalry.

Nor did it try.

Its purpose was to keep differences from destroying the knowledge each guild had accumulated.

But there were questions for which no agreement was enough.

The most dangerous began when researchers decided to study what remained after death.
lore.aptitudes.cosmology.echoes.title: The Footprint of the Fallen
lore.aptitudes.cosmology.echoes.body:
The first scholars of death observed that certain manifestations persisted after the last breath.

They were not living bodies.

Nor could they be described with certainty as complete minds.

Some researchers called them Echoes.

Their origin and persistence baffled the masters of the First Era.

One part of the guilds held that they should only be studied.

Others saw in them the chance to understand what separated life from death.

That difference seemed insignificant.

In time it became one of the great disagreements of the civilization.
lore.aptitudes.cosmology.veil_frontier.b:
Researchers discovered that the dimensions were not completely isolated.

There were phenomena able to cross certain frontiers, though most living beings never perceived them.

They called them, together, the Veil.

At first they believed all its regions obeyed the same laws.

Later they discovered that some frontiers offered extraordinary resistance.

They did not seem to protect a city, a tomb or any known kingdom.

They simply barred the way.

No one knew what lay behind them.

And, for a time, no one thought it necessary to find out.
lore.aptitudes.faction.permanence.title: The Researchers of Permanence
lore.aptitudes.faction.permanence.body:
Mortality had been accepted for generations as an unavoidable condition.

But the discoveries about the persistence of Essence raised new questions.

Could a consciousness be preserved after death?

Could someone's knowledge be preserved even when their body was gone?

The researchers of the Conclave sought answers.

Not all of them wished to reach immortality.

Some meant to understand the fate of memory. Others hoped to keep whole generations of knowledge from being lost.

When they detected signals coming from an inaccessible region of the Veil, they believed they had found a sign of what they sought.

They still did not know what waited on the other side.
lore.aptitudes.chronology.first_answer.b:
The instruments registered a signal they could not explain.

The researchers repeated the experiment.

The signal returned.

They began to pose questions and discovered patterns that seemed to answer them.

Soon answers arrived containing unknown knowledge.

Some members of the Conclave claimed to have found a consciousness able to survive without a body.

Others suspected that presence had never been human.

The experiments continued.

No surviving document indicates that the entity demanded a communication mechanism be built.

But the answers gradually guided the researchers toward that possibility.

And they chose to follow them.
The researchers built an object capable of holding a signal and amplifying it through Essence.

Its original purpose was to establish more intense communication with the unknown region of the Veil.

The experiment exceeded all expectations.

When the connection reached unprecedented strength, an alien will managed to exert influence over the world.

The artifact survived the disaster.

The last guardians of the First Era did not dare destroy it.

They shut it away behind four chambers and entrusted its protection to machines that would keep obeying even after their creators were gone.
lore.aptitudes.event.first_eclipse.title: The Night of the First Fall
lore.aptitudes.event.first_eclipse.body:
The ancient accounts describe a darkened sky and creatures that stopped obeying their own instincts.

The roads became unsafe.

The defenses built to stop ordinary invasions proved insufficient.

The guilds mobilized their masters and fighters.

The researchers tried to close the connection they had opened.

The phenomenon ended before what remained behind the Veil managed to cross it.

But the First Era never fully recovered its former splendor.

Disputes intensified, routes were abandoned and archives were scattered.

For generations, the survivors would remember that event by a single name:

The First Eclipse.
lore.aptitudes.temple.last_mandate.title: The Last Mandate
lore.aptitudes.temple.last_mandate.body:
The sanctuary was not built to grant rewards to those who proved strong enough.

It was prepared to keep the First Era's most dangerous knowledge from being used again.

The access mechanisms were secured.

An Automaton was instructed to guard the corridors.

The Custodian remained beside the inner chambers, equipped with the four keys that controlled their locks.

No machine was meant to interpret the intentions of visitors.

They were to obey.

The last human guardians vanished, but their orders went on being carried out.
lore.aptitudes.event.current_eclipse.bod:
The flame consumed the relic and a signal crossed the Veil.

The world seemed to stop for an instant.

Then came the darkness.

Creatures began to behave in extraordinary ways. Some pursued adventurers with unfamiliar persistence; others seemed to overcome obstacles that would once have stopped them.

There was no army descending from another plane.

The presence made use of what already dwelled in the world.

For the first time since the events of the First Era, the imprisoned will had found another chance to extend its influence.
lore.aptitudes.event.silent_fracture.bod:
The sky regained its appearance.

The pursuers ended their hunt and the Bonfires burned as before.

The survivors believed the threat had vanished.

But the confinement had not returned to its original state.

In a region of the Veil, an alteration persisted that had not existed before the event.

The prison remained closed.

Its occupant remained isolated.

Yet one of the frontiers that had held since the Great Separation had been weakened.

The Eclipse had ended.

Its consequences had not.
lore.aptitudes.arc2.unfinished_oath.body:
The Wardens of the Seals held that the confinement must be preserved.

The Disciples of the Threshold maintained that no prison could be understood solely through the fear its occupant inspired.

The former had witnessed the consequences of the contact.

The latter had found signs that the confinement was born of the natural separation of the worlds.

Both traditions kept important truths.

Neither knew the whole story.

The Fracture still existed.

There was no proven method to repair it, but no sufficient reason to open it either.

The last documents left a warning:

Before deciding the fate of what remains confined, it will be necessary to understand why the universe set it apart from the rest of its worlds.
lore.aptitudes.bestiary.errante_velado.b:
Not all the dead return in their old form.

Some seem to drag along fragments of what they were, as if their existence had been trapped between two states.

The Veiled Wanderer carries an unsettling presence, hidden beneath the remains of decayed garments and a spectral veil.

The scholars of the First Era would have recognized in it signs of an incomplete manifestation of Essence.

We still do not know whether it keeps memories of its former life.

We only know that something remains.
The ancient researchers observed that certain remains could retain extraordinary manifestations even after every recognizable sign of life had vanished.

The Broken Ossuary represents one of those phenomena.

Its existence raises a question that baffled the masters of the First Era:

Can Essence hold material remains together without a consciousness to govern them?

The records offer no definitive answer.
lore.aptitudes.bestiary.ancient_automato:
The engineers of the First Era built machines able to carry out orders long after their operators had abandoned the facilities.

The Ancient Automaton stands as a testament to that knowledge.

It does not fight out of hatred or ambition.

It remains where its builders left it, fulfilling a function whose importance may have been lost over the centuries.

Its defeat does not necessarily mean the end of an evil threat.

It may mean that an ancient defense has ceased to function.
lore.aptitudes.bestiary.custodio_cuatro_:
The Custodian was conceived to protect the mechanisms of an exceptional sanctuary.

The four keys bound to its structure controlled access to the inner chambers.

It does not judge the intentions of those who approach.

It does not tell a thief from an adventurer seeking answers.

Its function is to bar the way.

For generations it carried out that order.

Whoever manages to defeat it will discover that some doors were closed for reasons very different from guarding a treasure.
lore.aptitudes.bestiary.escorificador_hi:
The Iron Slagger belongs to the threats that accompany the incursions from the Nether and to those that dwell in its territories.

Its presence in the Overworld is a reminder that dimensional frontiers can be altered through extraordinary connections.

Not every fracture of the Veil leads to the places no researcher ever reached.

Some open paths to regions adventurers already know, though their inhabitants do not belong to the world they have crossed.
When the fog covers the roads, villagers recall ancient tales of creatures that return from death.

Some claim the phenomenon began after the fall of the First Era.

Others insist it existed before the guilds.

No testimony has fully explained its origin.

Researchers found signs of manifestations related to the Echoes of Essence, but their documents were left incomplete.

The fog does not necessarily announce the arrival of what the guilds feared.

It may represent a different alteration of the frontiers that separate matter from certain residual manifestations.
lore.aptitudes.event.ember_rain_chronicl:
Portals allow crossing distances that the ordinary laws of the world would keep apart.

But some connections can temporarily upset the balance between dimensions.

The Ember Rain is a manifestation of that danger.

Creatures from the Nether burst into the Overworld, bringing threats many settlements are not prepared for.

The phenomenon recalls a forgotten teaching of the researchers of the Veil:

Opening a path between two worlds does not mean controlling what may travel it.
lore.aptitudes.event.eclipse_chronicle.b:
During the First Eclipse, the masters of the First Era discovered that an external will could exert influence over creatures of the world.

Long afterward, the sacrifice of an offering allows that connection to be established again.

The champions and elites affected gain an extraordinary ability to seek out their targets.

The phenomenon is not the liberation of the Prisoner.

It is a temporary manifestation of its will.

And, while adventurers struggle to survive, something remains hidden behind the frontiers of the Veil.
